reason: The hypothesis synthesizes thermodynamic predictions of B2 ordering from P5–P9 with the kinetic phase-selection concept from P2–P4 and the Cr-induced phase-separation tendency from P23/P39, and applies this combined thermodynamic–kinetic framework to a specific new composition (Cr39Co18Fe18Ni18Al7) that is not studied in any passage. The explicit mechanistic link between Cr-imposed nucleation barrier and the kinetic suppression of ordering is not stated in any single passage, making this a synthesis of multiple sources into a proposal none of them individually suggests.
